message.content: Starting triage on the flagged wall penetration — shrinking to the minimal case.
Shrunk to a single fast body hitting a thin wall. Now I'll verify it replays and inspect the impact.
Replay confirmed. Checking states around the violation to trace the penetration.
Ledger: open – fast body vs thin wall tunneling/penetration; ruled out none yet. Inspecting pre-impact steps.
Just before impact the body was clear; checking earlier states to measure per-step travel.
Body travels ~0.64 per step toward a 0.1-thick wall but substeps ~0.03, so penetration looks like failed contact resolution, not missed substeps. Testing a slower-speed counterfactual next.
